title: Number of Matching Subsequences
description: Given a lowercase string `s` and an array of lowercase strings `words`, return the number of elements `words[i]` that are subsequences of `s`. Duplicate words in `words` are counted each time they appear if they are subsequences of `s`.
hints: Checking each word against s from scratch takes O(|words| * |s|), which can be too slow.
Group waiting words into 26 buckets keyed by their next needed character, and scan s once advancing only the bucket for s[i].

examples.explanation: "a", "acd", and "ace" are subsequences of "abcde", while "bb" is not.
"ahjpjau" and "ahbwzgqnuk" are subsequences of `s`, giving count 2.
Duplicate valid words like ["aa", "aa"] are each counted.
